title: Comptes rendus de la 26e réunion de la Conférence générale des poids et mesures
authors: General Conference on Weights and Measures
version: Official French and English proceedings of the 2018 meeting. Resolution DOI 10.59161/CGPM2018RES1E.

passages.locator: Seventh session, 16 November 2018, item 54, French p. 204 and English p. 465
passages.note: Unanimous adoption of draft A as Resolution 1.
Sets 20 May 2019 as the effective date, fixes the numerical value of the Planck constant and abrogates the definition based on the IPK.
